title: Open Coffee source allow-list
description: Every source a record may cite. Adding or changing an entry is a human-reviewed pull request.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of the schema version this file follows.

sources.description: The allow-listed sources. A record may only cite a source_id listed here.

name.description: Full name of the source, for example Foursquare Open Source Places.

kind.description: What sort of source it is. open_dataset: openly licensed bulk data; roaster_page: a roaster's list of cafés serving its coffee; primary_website: the place's or company's own website; social_profile: its own social media profile; web_search: a search engine, for finding pages only; open_knowledge: Wikidata and similar; image_repository: openly licensed images such as Wikimedia Commons; community: submissions from owners and contributors; verification_api: an API used only to confirm a known place; manufacturer_page: an equipment maker's own pages; retailer_page: a shop's product pages; standards_body: a standards organisation or association.

licence.description: SPDX identifier, or a short statement such as 'facts only, no copyright claimed'.

attribution.description: Attribution text that must accompany data derived from this source.

allowed_for.description: What the source may be used for. discovery: finding candidates; facts: values we store; images: photos with their licence; verification: confirming a place exists, without storing its data.

how_to_use.description: Instructions for people and the data agent: what to take from the source, what to leave out and which licence conditions to follow.

vetted.description: A maintainer checked the licence and terms.
